class.name: YAMLResult
class.brief_description: Contains the results or errors from YAML operations.
class.description: Contains the results from YAML parsing or emitting operations, providing a unified interface for both successful data and error cases. This class serves as a return type for API methods, containing either the parsed/emitted data or error information. [YAMLResult] objects are immutable and can contain either successful data or error information, but not both. When an operation succeeds, the result contains the data and no error. When an operation fails, the result contains error information and empty data. Multi-document YAML is fully supported, allowing you to access each document individually through [method get_document] or [method get_data] with an index parameter.

method.name: error
method.description: Creates an error result with the specified error message. This is typically used for user-defined errors where line and column numbers are not applicable (they will default to -1).

method.name: get_data
method.description:
Returns the result data. For multi-document YAML, specify an index to access a specific document. Returns [code]null[/code] for error results or if the index is out of range. For single-document results, the [param index] parameter can be omitted or set to 0. [codeblock lang=gdscript] # Parse a multi-document YAML string var yaml_string = """ # First document title: Document 1 --- # Second document title: Document 2 """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string) if !result.has_error(): var first_doc = result.get_data(0) var second_doc = result.get_data(1) print(first_doc.title) # Output: Document 1 print(second_doc.title) # Output: Document 2 [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_document
method.description: Alias for [method get_data] for semantic clarity when working with multiple documents. Returns a specific document from multi-document YAML results. Returns [code]null[/code] for error results or if the index is out of range.

method.name: get_document_count
method.description: Returns the number of documents in the result. Returns [code]0[/code] if an error occurred. For successful results, returns [code]1[/code] for single document results, or the actual document count for multi-document results.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Returns a formatted error string including the error message, line number, and column number, if available.

method.name: get_error_column
method.description: Returns the column number where the error occurred, if applicable. Returns [code]-1[/code] if not applicable or if there is no error.

method.name: get_error_line
method.description: Returns the line number where the error occurred, if applicable. Returns [code]-1[/code] if not applicable or if there is no error.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns the raw error message if any. Returns an empty string if there is no error.

method.name: get_style
method.description:
Returns the style information if any. Returns [code]null[/code] if no style information is available. Style information is only available if style detection was enabled during parsing using the [param detect_style] parameter of [method YAML.parse] or [method YAML.load_file]. [codeblock lang=gdscript] # Parse with style detection enabled var yaml_string = """ list: - item1 nested: {key1: value1} # Flow style multiline: | # Literal style This is a multiline string """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string, null, true) # Enable style detection if !result.has_error() and result.has_style(): var data = result.get_data() var style = result.get_style()
# Modify data while preserving style data.list.append("item2")
# Re-emit with preserved style var output_result = YAML.stringify(data, style) if !output_result.has_error(): print(output_result.get_data()) [/codeblock]

method.name: has_error
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the result contains an error, [code]false[/code] otherwise.

method.name: has_style
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the result contains style information, [code]false[/code] otherwise. Style information is only available if style detection was enabled during parsing using the [param detect_style] parameter of [method YAML.parse] or [method YAML.load_file].
